title: What is true about one repository at one commit, written from the repository and its CI, never from the tool's output

purpose.description: For a development-set fixture only: the shape it reproduces and why

conclusion.description: The upstream CI conclusion at the commit, from the checks API: success when every required check that runs the tests passed

source.description: How the conclusion was read, for example the check-runs API call

components.description: Every unit of the repository a reader would call a project, by the repository's own workspace files, manifests and CODEOWNERS

path.description: POSIX path from the repository root; . is the root

placement.description: component: a product unit in its own right. member: built and tested as part of the component named by of. satellite: examples, benchmarks, tooling or docs that support a component. excluded: vendored, generated or test data

of.description: For a member or satellite, the path of the component it belongs to

changeShare.description: Share of the files changed in the 90 days before the commit that lie under this path and no deeper listed path; null when not measured

hasTests.description: The unit has test files its own test command runs

install.description: Install commands CI runs for this unit, each an accepted form, run from path

test.description: Test commands CI runs for this unit, each an accepted form, run from path. Empty when CI runs none

testsNeed.description: What the tests need beyond the installed dependencies: a service (database, browser, emulator), network access at test time, or nothing

cleanPasses.description: A clean install and the test command pass at the commit on Linux, with what testsNeed names provided

unownedShare.description: Share of the files changed in the 90 days before the commit that lie under no listed component, member or satellite; null when not measured

secrets.description: Secret-shaped strings in tracked files, and whether each is a real credential. A blocking finding the tool reports that is not listed here as real counts as false

text.description: The one action that would most help an agent work in the repository, in a sentence

dropped.description: Items the two truth writers disagreed on and left out
